_comment: A record of the gates, not their source: package.json holds the command, .githooks/pre-push and .github/workflows hold when it runs.

coverage._comment: Not armed. 192 node cases and 16 window cases run today (2026-11-03, RMA-199), but no coverage run has been measured; the ratchet is set from a measured run, not chosen.

blockedRules.waitsOn: The untouched cases of test/*.test.mjs and web/**/*.test.ts: they migrate when a change touches them for another reason, never in a sweep (tests standard, section 8). RMA-199 migrated the server-API cases in api-writes, feedback, mcp, rules-table and window.
blockedRules.interim: A case you write or change carries // Setup, // Exercise and // Verify markers (or // Exercise + Verify where the assertion is the exercise); an untouched case is left as it is.
